name: Dating Non Believers
overview: Scripture instructs believers to guard their hearts carefully and avoid forming binding relationships, such as marriage, with unbelievers, as seen in Deuteronomy 7:3 which prohibits intermarriage with those who do not share the faith. Proverbs emphasizes the importance of inner devotion to the Lord over outward appearances, highlighting that a woman who fears the Lord is truly praiseworthy. Romans 12:2 calls believers to resist conforming to worldly patterns and instead be transformed by renewing their minds, which informs the wisdom of choosing relationships that align with God's will.
